name: Sicklecloak
description: The weight turns in a slow ring beside the user, who stands ready to pin whatever it touches.

name: Harpooning Rodhandle
description: Each forward step adds a turn to the whirl, and the weight lands as the rear foot comes through.

name: Facet Weightswing
description: A loop of chain is flung open at the opponent's torso and trails the weight like a net.

name: Sickleblade Fastness
description: Both hands haul the chain at once, tearing a hooked weapon or limb out of the opponent's guard.

name: Entwine Hauberk
description: The whirling weight is steered into a spiral of coils around a limb and held fast with steady qi.

name: Granite Tangle
description: Releasing the coils in one rapid unspooling, the user slings the weight in a spiral onto the bound target.

name: Dominating Lashcut
description: Many coils pinned by qi tension hold an arm and its weapon fixed while the kama works at the open flank.

name: Scything Shade Snare
description: Three weight casts come from three angles in a row and keep the opponent crouched behind a frantic guard.

name: Hoarfrost Chainlength
description: The kama's hook leads at chest height with the weight hanging slack, covering the front approach.

name: Sanguine Tangknob
description: With the chain paid out the hook rakes from the full length of the user's arm and a pace beyond.

name: Skinning Chainloop
description: The weight is thrown in a flat curve around the raised blade and hits the opponent's ear.

name: Hastening Ballbind
description: The user glides on the balls of the feet, keeping the hook at a steady distance from the opponent.

name: Hoarfrost Sicklehook
description: The hook snaps out as the opponent advances and catches the leading ankle or sleeve to halt the charge.

name: Mayhemkama
description: A hooked wrist is dragged back as the user lunges, folding the opponent's reach into their own chest.

name: Blaze Sicklepull
description: The hook pulls the opponent's guard arm down and the weight swings in over it to the face.

name: Furrowing Pommelring
description: The kama's point is thrown the length of the chain with qi behind it and pierces padded cloth or light plate.

name: Lot Chainkey
description: A running series of hook, pull and cast carries the opponent across the ground without a moment to set.

name: Resilient Weightball
description: Kama in one hand and weight in the other, the user stands poised so that either can swing out and balance the other.

name: Mightkama
description: The weight swings back past the hip and its momentum drives the kama's cut forward with extra force.

name: Chime Lashcut
description: With the back of the hand leading, the weight is whipped across the body at an opponent on the blade side.

name: Equipoise Rodhandle
description: The chain catches a thrusting weapon and the user pivots, sliding the point harmlessly past.

name: Gustsnare
description: Each step follows the weight's swing, so the swinging chain pulls the feet into position.

name: Equipoise Tangknob
description: Balanced on blade and weight, the user keeps a small qi-fed ring turning that checks every blow from the front.

name: Thorn Sicklehook
description: The weight is laid over the opponent's blade and pressed down against it with the user's kama hooked beneath.

name: Furrowing Chainkey
description: A half turn converts the guarding ring into a slashing arc that finishes with the kama's edge.

name: Lancing Tangle
description: Weight and thrown kama go out together from opposite sides, so one is parried and the other lands.

name: Sicklehauberk
description: The weight is staked in the ground and the chain drawn taut at ankle height so a charging foe is thrown.

name: Facet Weightball
description: Kama and chain held in a loose, relaxed pose that gives nothing away and can answer from any side.

name: Sicklethrash
description: A short quick drag of the blade across the target ends before the opponent has seen it begin.

name: Tanglebarrage
description: A snap of the wrist alone sends the weight out on a short, hard line with no wind-up.

name: Murk Pommelring
description: The chain meets a cut at an angle and rolls it off to the side without taking its full force.

name: Iron Ballbind
description: The weight is whipped at the head and then dropped to the knee in one flowing, unbroken motion.

name: Chime Chainlength
description: The hook catches an incoming weapon and throws it wide, leaving the opponent's guard open.

name: Lot Sicklepull
description: Chain lashes and kama cuts alternate in a closed rhythm, each covering the opening of the one before it.

name: Daybreak Chainloop
description: Spinning on the spot, the user sends kama and weight around a full circle that cuts all within the chain's reach.

name: Charter Sickleblade
description: Blade hand and weight hand are held at equal height, each guarding while the other prepares to strike.

name: Blaze Sicklehook
description: The kama travels in a clean high curve from shoulder to hip, like the sweep of a sky-bound wing.

name: Ravaging Chainlength
description: Two quick casts of the weight follow the same line, so the second hits where the first was blocked.

name: Granite Snare
description: The user curves around the opponent's charge in a smooth bend, like a river around a stone.

name: Chime Weightball
description: Chain and haft spread like two wings and catch a blow between them, shedding its force sideways.

name: Stifling Entwine
description: Weight hand and blade hand pull in opposite directions and yank a snagged weapon from the opponent's grip.

name: Blazesnare
description: The kama draws the opponent's eye and guard while the weight arrives from the other track.

name: Thorn Weightswing
description: Two loops of chain, cast one after the other, close around the opponent's wrist and the weapon it holds.

name: Lancing Chainloop
description: Stepping in a half circle, the user sweeps the weight along the ground and takes both of the opponent's ankles.

name: Kusarithrash
description: Blade and weight dive on the opponent from high and low together like a pair of hawks, forcing a split guard.

name: Doctrine Snare
description: Two interleaved lines of attack, one from the blade and one from the weight, run until a guard fails.

name: Granite Ballbind
description: The user stands tall on one braced leg with the kama raised like a folded wing and the chain overhead.

name: Ironkama
description: From a height above the head the weight drops on a short chain and hammers the opponent's guard.

name: Blaze Weightswing
description: The weight flies in a long straight line that does not sag until it strikes its target.

name: Kusariplating
description: The kama's tip sinks into clothing like a talon and drags the opponent a step toward the user.

name: Gustsickle
description: The weight circles high above the user's head, covering all sides and ready to dive on any foe.

name: Chime Pommelring
description: The hook snatches a weapon or limb for the length of a breath, then lets go to fling it aside.

name: Blazesickle
description: A dive that seems aimed at the head is turned at the last instant into a low cut to the knee.

name: Tangle Torment
description: A weight loosed from a high arc under qi falls almost vertically and drives through a raised shield or helm.

name: Hamstringing Sickleblade
description: The chain is flung wide and the hook draws its edges closed around the opponent like a net of talons.

name: Facet Rodhandle
description: Feet set on a curved line, the user holds the kama at the rim of an imagined bowl and guards the whole front.

name: Ironsickle
description: A long drawing pull of the kama carves a clean line through the opponent's lead forearm.

name: Chimetangle
description: The weight is cast in a long, unhurried curve that the opponent misjudges and meets with the wrong parry.

name: Sickleplating
description: A small spinning turn of the hook catches the blade and circles it away like a leaf in an eddy.

name: Racing Sicklepull
description: One foot steps toward the opponent and the other follows the weight's swing to the side, splitting the approach.

name: Vigorous Tangknob
description: A light brush of the weight against the opponent's guard tells the user where and how hard it is held.

name: Fastening Sicklehook
description: Loop after loop of chain is cast until the opponent's arms are filled and circled like a brimming bowl.

name: Facet Chainkey
description: The weight leaves the hand as if bound one way, then curves back along the bend and strikes the other flank.

name: Scything Lashcut
description: Kama and weight cross each other at the opponent's wrist like the two blades of a shear.

name: Rumble Entwine
description: A hooked arm is spun in a small circle as the user backs away, leaving the opponent turned and off balance.

name: Noxious Ballbind
description: A chain laid on the ground in a hidden loop closes on the first leg that steps into it.

name: Mayhemkusari
description: The user cuts a full circle around the body with kama and weight, striking all who stand at its rim.

name: Aegis Tangknob
description: Planted square like a post sunk in rock, the user holds the kama forward and lets the chain trail.

name: Iron Snare
description: The kama cuts into the wind's push, which adds speed to its return stroke across the opponent's arm.

name: Novasickle
description: Standing near an edge, the user casts the weight in a long line across the gap to the opposite side.

name: Granite Chainloop
description: Moving with a gust at the back, the user slips sideways of a charge in a single light stride.

name: Manacling Chainkey
description: The chain is cast along a straight sworn line and wraps the opponent's weapon where it stands.

name: Mayhem Tangle
description: Holding the same bearing as the cast, the user hauls the weight straight back through whatever stands in its path.

name: Gust Entwine
description: The whole length of chain is paid out in one spinning cast that drives the weight across an open yard.

name: Siltkama
description: On open ground the user whirls kama and weight in wide turns that cut anyone who tries to close.

name: Immovable Sickleblade
description: Weight on the balls of the feet and the chain gathered at the hip, the user stands steady on a narrow line.

name: Might Pommelring
description: The hooked tip cuts along the line between opponent and drop, driving them to keep clear of the lip.

name: Drubbing Rodhandle
description: The weight is flung so low that it skims the rock and strikes the opponent's leading foot.

name: Murk Tangknob
description: Turning on the rim's curve, the user's chain meets a cut and sends it off into open air.

name: Granite Lashcut
description: A long, even pace that eats ground along flat country and keeps the chain from tangling the feet.

name: Ponderous Pommelring
description: The hook sets in the opponent's belt and the chain is hauled to turn them away from the user's open flank.

name: Murksickle
description: The user sways as if about to slip, drawing the opponent in, then snaps the weight into their path.

name: Nova Sicklepull
description: The weight is thrown to wrap the opponent's leg and pin it to the ground at the rim.

name: Ponderous Chainlength
description: Hooking the opponent at the lip, the user hauls them off balance toward the drop and cuts as they stumble.

name: Sickletorment
description: Cuts and casts are chained along the rim without a pause, each pushing the opponent one step nearer the drop.

name: Aegiskusari
description: Facing the wind with the kama low, the user stands on a fixed bearing and watches the opponent over it.

name: Rumbletangle
description: The weight is lofted high into open air and falls onto the opponent from directly overhead.

name: Scything Tangle
description: The weight follows a perfectly straight line fixed by the user's sworn bearing and never wavers.

name: Remnant Sickleblade
description: A held-up hand and a flick of the chain show the wind's strength and let the user correct the cast.

name: Gyve Weightswing
description: Using the wind's pull, the chain is cast so it curls around the opponent's body on its own.

name: Silt Ballbind
description: The user changes bearing in a step and pulls, dragging the opponent's weapon onto the new line.

name: Harrowing Rodhandle
description: The hook goes out on the wind and returns with it, cutting the opponent twice on one throw.

name: Kamabarrage
description: Wherever there are no walls to hem it in, the weight spirals outward in widening reaps that clear the ground.

name: Thorn Weightball
description: A chain cast on the held bearing locks around the opponent and the user's oath-steady grip keeps it tight.
